review_prompts: Can normal launch reach any compiler package manager Git mutable download or model pull path?
Can Terraform destroy or a trap delete the persistent warm volumes?
Are timing denominators complete and comparable?

findings.summary: Resume reads launch instance output keys rather than preparation instance output keys and therefore rejects every non-terminal interrupted preparation.
Focused helper tests do not yet execute the integrated resume, controller propagation, checkpoint reconciliation, and terminal recovery-refusal paths claimed by retained proof.

residual_risk: Prepared artifacts remain retained and no compute is running while the integrated no-paid resume harness is corrected.
